description: Judge A/B experiment on the iGPU laptop (Intel Arc): identical contestants and settings to laptop_judge, but the judge is qwen3:8b -- cross-family to BOTH contestants -- with thinking off, matching the llama3.1:8b judge's effective behavior so the judge model is the only changed variable. The two scenarios are the code duels whose llama-judged verdicts credited claimed features over the code-run record (factorial: 5 ok / 3 failed; program_writing: 3 ok / 5 failed); compare how this judge treats crashed programs. The judge context auto-sizer is again left unset on purpose. Pull the judge first: ollama pull qwen3:8b. (Its qwen3:8b judge is the laptop profile's own, so it extends laptop directly.)
